text:
Nina (People Ops): quick manager + self-review skeleton. designed for managers who want clean evidence-first notes and for ICs who hate long forms. paste into 1:1s or review tools.

Nina (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW SKELETON (3 short lines)
1) Situation + outcome (1 line): what you owned & metric.
2) What you did (1 line): actions you led or decisions you made.
3) Ask (1 line): one thing you want from your manager/org next cycle.

Nina (People Ops): STAR MINI (use when you need a slightly longer example)
- Situation: short context.
- Task: the goal you owned.
- Action: 1-2 bullets, concrete contributions.
- Result: metric or customer outcome.

Owen (Eng Manager): can you add a manager email template to send to peers for calibration quickly?

Nina (People Ops): MANAGER CALIBRATION EMAIL (paste)
- Subject: Quick input for calibration on <name>
- Body:
  Hi <peer>,
  Were calibrating <name> for the end-of-cycle review. Could you reply with one sentence about their cross-team impact and one sentence about reliability/execution? Example: "Led the autoscaler rollout across infra & product teams; reduced cost 18% and cut incidents by 30%."
  Thanks — will keep it to 2 lines.

Rach (IC): can the self-review include a neutral "missed goal" phrasing? want it to show learning, not blame.

Nina (People Ops): MISSED-GOAL LINE (neutral)
- "Goal not met due to X (owner: team Y); shipped mitigation A and scheduled remaining work with clear owner/date."

Ivy (Recruiter): request: include hiring-signal line with priority. helps prioritize reqs.

Nina (People Ops): HIRING SIGNAL (one line to paste)
- "Hiring suggestion (priority: high/med/low): <role> because <one-line rationale>."

Owen (Eng Manager): small manager note: when you paste a highlight, include a single link (PR/metric/dash) so calibration reviewers can check quickly.

Nina (People Ops): agreed. added a tiny checklist managers can use in a 15m review:
- 0-2m: confirm the 3 self-review lines.
- 2-8m: manager highlight + link.
- 8-12m: discuss one blocker & owner.
- 12-15m: agree on 2 actions for next cycle.

PrepBot (reminder-bot): Reminder scheduled: post self-review 48h before meeting (timestamp 1810160000).

Rach (IC): this is short enough to actually do. thanks :thumbsup:

Nina (People Ops): happy to make role-specific variants (SRE, PM, Data). ping me and ill drop tailored lines.
